text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer Splinter on Dedicated cluster eu-west-1-ded-42. 5m error rate 12.4% (threshold 5%). Auto-escalation -> channel #incidents.

oncall-amber: I'm on it. paging eng-sre and runtime. region eu-west-1, cluster ded-42.

Alex J: Picking this up from oncall. First check: is this noisy-tenant or global capacity?

Raj P: Initial read from the gateway: spikes in 502/504 from model-proxy layer -> downstream queueing. Looks like requests are getting queued then failing.

Emily T: Customer reported increased latencies 10:30 UTC, started ~10:26. Is Splinter on a reserved capacity plan?

CS Liaison: Yes, Splinter on Dedicated (reserved). They are running medium+ burst config. Notified account owner about increased errors, told them we're investigating.

Priya M: Prom query for 5xx by tenant:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",response_code=~"5..",tenant="splinter"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",tenant="splinter"}[5m])) * 100
```
Result: 12.4% as the bot said. Gateway latency p95 up from 120ms -> 850ms.

Marco R: Checking node metrics on ded-42: GPU util on a subset of nodes at 98%, KV cache miss rate spiked, and OOM evictions in the runtime logs.

Alex J: That smells like noisy-neighbor + KV thrashing. Any recent deploys for splinter?

Priya M: No customer-side deploys flagged. But we did push a runtime kernel tweak to eu-west-1 yesterday (canary). Rollout at 02:00 UTC marked +10% traffic to new kernel.

Raj P: Can we correlate kernel variant with noisy nodes? Querying: `label_replace(upstream_kernel_build_info,...)` -> nodes 10.0.12.*/10.0.12.9 serving many splinter shards.

oncall-amber: Action plan proposal: 1) Temporarily reroute Splinter traffic off the most impacted nodes. 2) Throttle large connections/streams from Splinter for 10m. 3) If necessary, spawn additional worker pool (burst) and drain saturated nodes.

Alex J: Agreed. Prioritize traffic reroute and throttling. Raj, can you run the routing override?

Raj P: Running route override now: `redwood route override --tenant splinter --exclude-node 10.0.12.9 --duration 15m`

incident-bot: command accepted, override submitted (id=ovr-586420-01).

Emily T: Applying per-tenant concurrency limiter on gateway: `gatewayctl set-limits --tenant splinter --concurrency 40` (was 200).

Priya M: Adding temporary cache pin for Splinter prefix to reduce KV churn: `kvctl pin --tenant splinter --prefix /model_kv/splinter --ttl 600`

Marco R: Spawning 4 extra workers in ded-42 (burst). `k scale deploy/runtime-worker --replicas +4 -n eu-west-1` -> pods starting.

oncall-amber: Noting customer impact so far: about 4% of Splinter requests returned 5xx in last 30m (higher than normal), estimated ~1800 failed requests. CS notified.

CS Liaison: Sent customer note: "We're investigating increased errors, temporarily throttling non-essential traffic and scaling capacity. We'll update within 15 minutes."

Raj P: After routing override and throttle: 5xx rate dropped to 3.1% within 4m. p95 latency down to 310ms.

Alex J: Nice. Keep the override for another 10m and monitor. Raj, capture debug logs from 10.0.12.9 for postmortem.

Raj P: `scp ops@10.0.12.9:/var/log/runtime/*.log /tmp/splinter-eviction-logs/` in progress. Found repeated KV evict lines: `kv_cache: evict key=... age=2m reason=malloc`.

Priya M: I also see runtime OOMs at 10:26:18, 10:27:02, then kernel fallback events. Might be memory compaction regression in the canary kernel.

Marco R: Rolling back kernel variant on affected nodes: `deployctl rollback kernel-build 2026-06-09-canary --nodes 10.0.12.8-12.9` -> started.

incident-bot: rollback job queued (jobid rb-586420-02).

CS Liaison: Customer updated: "Appreciate quick response. We'll pause heavy batch jobs from our side for now."

Alex J: Once nodes are drained and rollback completes, we'll remove route override and restore concurrency limits gradually. Postmortem owners: Raj + Priya.

oncall-amber: Handoff: I'm stepping off oncall in 8m. Alex will remain primary. If errors creep back above 5%, page eng-sre manifest.

Emily T: Noted. I'll follow up on the rollback status and confirm kv pin TTL reset.

Priya M: Preliminary RCA: kernel memory compaction regression causing excessive malloc pressure -> KV evictions -> increased backend latency -> gateway 5xx. Will validate with canary rollout logs.

Alex J: Good. Draft incident timeline and customer impact metrics (total errors, p95 before/after, duration) and put in #postmortems when ready.

CS Liaison: Logged customer impact ticket CUST-9281 with notes and timeline.

Raj P: Uploading logs to /mnt/incidents/5864201122-splinter-logs.tar.gz and linking to the PMT.

incident-bot: All mitigations in place. Monitor for 30m. If stable, we'll resolve and start RCA writeup. :thumbsup:

oncall-amber: Thanks team. Leaving the channel.

Alex J: Keeping watch. Will update when rollback and drains finish (~+12m).

(12 minutes later)

Alex J: Rollback completed, drains finished, route override expired. 5xx at 0.9% now. Marking incident as mitigated.

Priya M: Confirming canary blocked; will open a rollout-blocker and coordinate a fix with runtime team.

CS Liaison: Customer confirmed errors are gone and thanked the team. I'll schedule a post-incident call with Splinter for later today.

Alex J: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owners Raj + Priya; please include kernel regression evidence and timeline. Closing thread once PMT entry created.
